label: independent-hand-written
method: 54 documents written by hand as literal text in evaluation/masking/independent/documents*.ts; no import from the benchmark generator (values.ts, doc.ts, layouts.ts, corpus.ts), no seeded values, no noise model
every person, company, address and number is invented; check digits computed with independent/check-digits.ts, written for this check
OCR damage in the scan category typed by hand per document
scored with the benchmark scorer evaluation/masking/score.ts unchanged (same matching rules and Wilson intervals)
the detector src/identifier-masking.ts was not changed for or after this measurement
definitions: caught: every letter and digit of the ground-truth span is inside some detection (any kind)
kindCorrect: caught, and every covering detection has the ground-truth kind
partial: some but not all letters and digits covered; counted as missed
true positive detection: overlaps a ground-truth identifier in at least one letter or digit
false positive detection: overlaps no ground-truth identifier (names and addresses are not promised kinds)
recall = caught / identifiers; precision = true positive detections / detections; 95% Wilson intervals
byKind: recall rows count ground-truth identifiers of that kind; precision rows count detections of that kind

namesAndAddresses.statement: Names and addresses are not promised kinds and are never detection targets: they are recorded only so that the result can say how many were left in clear text and how many a detection of a promised kind touched (a false-positive measure).
